decision: The competitor (Williams Martini Racing) is fined €200.
event_name: Date 25 August 2018 Time 13:31 2018 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 23 - 26 August 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 35 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this Event by 1.1 km/h. Garry Connelly Enzo Spano Mika Salo Yves Bacquelaine
